label: Trump · FBI · Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang

clips_and_posts.text: President Donald Trump on Sunday defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following reports that the chipmaker was investigating Huang's alleged links to a Chinese spy. Trump said he had not spoken to Huang about the reports but called him an “honorable guy.”
